Res.Caption: Auto Assign Tasks
Res.FullDescription: When ticked, tasks requiring this capability will be auto-assigned to the resource with the most available capacity, if its workflow is also set to auto assign tasks.

Res.Caption: Auto Assign Tasks Age
Res.FullDescription: The duration a workflow can spend in a buffer (using the buffer's Department and Branch hours) before it becomes eligible for auto-assignment. This age overrides the Release Group and the Component Ages. 000:00 indicates assignment immediately after release.
